sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('a6e652e1-b2e4-47ba-bed2-c5e902f8b8f1', '237a1f63-53ff-47fa-903c-ac6276e594a2') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
